elements.name: Cancel a file chooser while a ribbon edit is pending

steps.name: a part is active in the MCAD Software with the full Tools ribbon visible
ribbon customization shows All Commands and an initially empty Part Tools target
2D Sketches has been staged in the target list
the user clicks Import
the Import Customization Settings file chooser opens
the user clicks Cancel in the file chooser
the file chooser closes
2D Sketches remains in the Part Tools target list
the target shows a pending-change marker
Apply and cancels are available in the customization dialog
the user clicks Cancel in the customization dialog
the customization dialog closes
the Tools ribbon remains visible
